name: MCSRP6
tagline: Compact Alder Lake-N and Twin Lake network appliance with dual 2.5GbE
description: MCSRP6 is a compact aluminum-alloy network and edge appliance with dual Intel 2.5GbE LAN, DDR5 memory, dual 4K display output, wide 12-24V DC input, M.2 storage, and extensive internal expansion.

specifications.label: CPU
specifications.value: Intel Alder Lake-N N100 / N200 / Core i3-N305; Twin Lake N150 / N250 / Core i3-N355

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 1 x M.2 slot supporting NVMe or NGFF SATA SSD

specifications.label: Display
specifications.value: 1 x HDMI 2.0 and 1 x DisplayPort 1.4, both supporting 4K at 60Hz

features.title: Dual Intel 2.5GbE Networking
features.description: Two Intel i226-V interfaces for routing and edge-network deployments

features.title: Wide-Voltage DC Input
features.description: 12-24V DC input for flexible embedded installation

features.title: Flexible Expansion
features.description: M.2 storage, M.2 Wi-Fi, SFF-8654, GPIO, COM, eDP, fan, and front-panel connectivity

applications.title: Standard Interface Layout
applications.description: Clearly labeled front and rear connectivity

applications.title: Optional Expansion Panels
applications.description: Optional USB 2.0 or SFF-8654 and ATX power configurations

applications.title: Fan Mounting Support
applications.description: Reserved mounting holes for an 80 x 80 mm fan

applications.title: Application Scenarios
applications.description: AI robots, smart homes, smart hardware, soft routers, 3D printers, and education
